messages.subject: How to input cross_info ?
parts:
Hi Karl,

I hope to use the model for an AIL population that is inbred for 1 generation after F2. I was wondering how can I write the cross_info section in the control file. Now I keep getting the "cross_info is misspecified" warning message, and I couldn't find any documents addressing this problem online.

Also, would you implement the model for partially-inbred 2k-way RIL by sib-mating (prerisib) in the future by any chance?

Thank you,
Xuying

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] How to input cross_info ?
parts:
It would help if you would show some details on what you tried.

The cross information for AILs needs to have two columns: number of generations and a numeric indicator of the way in which the crosses were generated (AxB, BxA, or mixed), for the X chromosome. These would need to be proceeded by the individual IDs.
https://kbroman.org/qtl2/assets/vignettes/input_files.html#advanced_intercross_lines_(ail)

something like:

id,generation,direction
line1,3,2
line2,3,2
line3,3,2
line4,3,2
line5,3,2
line6,3,2

We don't have immediate plans to implement partially-inbred 2^k-way RILs.

karl
